question: The ratio of time taken by Aviral and Rupsa to complete a task is 5 : 4. If the total wages of Aviral and Rupsa is Rs. 18540 then find the wages of Rupsa.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__****Given:**

The ratio of time taken by Aviral and Rupsa = 5 : 4

**Concept Used:**

The number days taken to work is the reciprocal of the rate of the work i.e they are inversely proportional.

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6bd494050c94f33e6444d8c9e4711368866dacd34a039f448e28ee69fd8e3827.png] 

∴ The wages of Rupsa is Rs. 10,300. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__****Given:**

The ratio of time taken by Aviral and Rupsa = 5 : 4

**Concept Used:**

**T**he number days taken to work is the reciprocal of the rate of the work i.e they are inversely proportional.

**Calculation:**

Let the ratio of time taken by Aviral and Rupsa be 5x and 4x respectively

According to the question,

The efficiencies of Aviral = 4x

The efficiencies of Rupsa = 5x

Hence, 4x + 5x = 18,540

⇒ 9x = 18,540

⇒ x = 18,540/9

⇒ x = 2060

Wages of Rupsa = 5x 

⇒ 5x = 2060 × 5 

⇒ Rs. 10,300 

**∴ The wages of Rupsa is Rs. 10,300.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**Wage is inversely proportional to the time taken by the individual.
